title: Make your bed

steps.tip: Start at the pillows and walk to the foot of the bed.

steps.text: Pull the blanket up to the pillows.
steps.tip: Tug both sides so it hangs evenly.

steps.text: Put the pillow at the head of the bed.
steps.tip: Fluff it once with both hands.

done_when: Floor around the bed is clear
parent_notes: A 'good enough' made bed counts. Do not redo it in front of the child.
